Germany wins Hockey World Cup, matches Pakistan's record

Germany defeated Spain 1-0 to win the Men's Hockey World Cup, retaining their title. This victory marks Germany's fourth World Cup win, equalling Pakistan's record for the most successful team in the tournament's history. The final score was 1-0.
